input.title: Zombie Match beta player messages - team note (Oct 1 2025)
input.bodyText:
Zombie Match beta player messages: what we actually say to players
Oct 1 2025. Calls made with the Beta message rule. Full list, one row per message: "Zombie Match beta player messages - calls (Oct 1 2025)" (same folder).

1. Where we start: Sep 15 install cohort week (warehouse, USER_COHORT_RETENTION)
- iOS: 237 installs, D1 31.65%, D7 9.28%
- Android: 103 installs, D1 37.86%, D7 10.68%

2. The calls: 32 messages (14 PNs Beta rows + 18 asks)
- Go 3: Lapsed 1 day (DES-316), Lapsed 7 days (DES-317, new headline "Your Squad Is Waiting", string ticket DES-346), Weekly Leaderboard reset (DES-320). These are on the push notifications card checklist for Vincent.
- Hold 23: mostly asks the client doesn't schedule yet (test 3) or that need a server send (test 2). Held tickets go to Backlog, unassigned, per the BETA list rule.
- Drop 6: Hourly Coins, Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever, Axe Arena, Comeback gift (not in the beta), Lapsed 14 days (already covered by Lapsed 7 days).
The sheet said six were Ready; only three pass.

3. Lapsed reminders the client schedules, day by day
Scheduled from the last time the game was closed, and only for players whose notifications are on (our own ask after level 20, or switched on in settings).
- Day 1: "The Horde Is Growing... " (Lapsed 1 day) - Go
- Day 2 to 6: nothing
- Day 7: "They've Taken Over... Can You Stop Them?" -> becomes "Your Squad Is Waiting" (DES-346) - Go
- Day 14: same Lapsed 7 days message again
- Day 21: same Lapsed 7 days message again
- Day 28: same Lapsed 7 days message again (last one)
- Nothing on day 3 (DES-342, Hold) or day 30 (DES-343, Hold). Day 14 needs nothing new (DES-344 dropped).

4. Already scheduled by the client but still a Hold, and why
- Lives recharged (DES-315): test 6. Vincent took his tick off on Sep 30 - on iOS 0.3.49 it did not arrive after a full refill, twice.
- Finish first mission (DES-318): test 4. It's written for players below level 20, but our permission ask only runs after level 20 (Robert's call, Sep 29), so none of them count. The Unity popup at iOS launch doesn't switch anything on and the settings toggle doesn't count.
- Plague Race (DES-319): test 6. The iOS tick was on the 5-minute-timer build, which doesn't count. On the real iOS 0.3.40 store build it never arrived. Android is fine.

5. What Vincent needs to tick
Seen only counts on a store build on a real iOS and a real Android device. Lapsed 7 days has to be checked again once DES-346 ships.
